# Mark

> Mark makes SVG images for READMEs and websites from a URL: hero headers, badges, skill icons and live developer cards.

Public image URLs need no sign-up or API key. Embed the SVG URL in Markdown or HTML. Use the catalog for the current forms, themes, icons, parameters and limits.

## Start here

- [Studio](https://mark.sylphx.com/): Preview and customize an image, then copy its URL.
- [Documentation](https://mark.sylphx.com/docs): Image routes, examples and compatibility parameters.
- [API catalog](https://mark.sylphx.com/api/v1/catalog): Machine-readable vocabulary and size limits.
- [Source](https://github.com/SylphxAI/readme-mark): Source code and usage documentation.

## Image examples

- [Hero header](https://mark.sylphx.com/api/v1/mark/hero.svg?text=Hello&theme=dark): Customize text, description, art, theme, dimensions and animation.
- [Static badge](https://mark.sylphx.com/badge/build-passing-brightgreen.svg): A label-message-color badge; supports styles and logos.
- [Skill icons](https://mark.sylphx.com/icons?i=rust,ts,react): A grid of technology icons.
- [GitHub stars](https://mark.sylphx.com/github/stars/SylphxAI/readme-mark.svg): A live repository badge.
